claims.statement: EU work-equipment rules require periodic or special inspections, recorded results, and physical evidence when equipment is used outside the undertaking.
Demand hypothesis: dealer and rental channels will pay for a neutral ledger because fleet programs already track repair status, coverage, and downtime.

contrary_evidence: Rental-management systems already track inspections and damage.
Large OEM fleet programs may keep customers inside proprietary portals.

economics.acquisition_route: Integrate with a regional rental-software vendor or dealer network.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 30000 assets at 18 PLN monthly can exceed 6 million PLN ARR and support founder net worth above 5 million PLN in five years.
economics.founder_time: Three to four hours daily with field setup delegated to channel partners.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 80-90% margin for evidence capture and routing.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 3000 active assets at 15 PLN monthly repay initial capital within eighteen months.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 10-30 PLN per asset monthly plus 50-150 PLN per resolved damage case.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every rental cycle creates a new inspection and custody event.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Asset, user, damage, repair, and claim histories improve risk scoring and residual-value decisions.
fingerprint.customer: Construction equipment rental firms, dealers, and equipment insurers.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Rental-software vendors and equipment dealers embed it in fleet and repair modules.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Mobile handoff and inspection capture creates a defensible evidence timeline and routes each exception.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The rental platform, dealer, or fleet owner pays per active asset monthly.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An inspection expires or returned equipment shows damage that must be allocated among renter, fleet, warranty, and insurer.

founder_fit: The ledger is data-intensive and automatable.
Channel-led deployment avoids constant field sales.
risks: Images and telematics may not prove causation.
Local inspection rules vary by asset and country.

structure.control_point: The serial-level inspection and custody history.
structure.critical_dependency: Consistent handoff capture and fleet-system integration.

thesis: A serial-level ledger can join mandatory inspections, handoff condition, telematics, repairs, and damage-waiver claims for equipment rental fleets.
title: Rental Equipment Inspection-to-Claim Ledger
uncertainties: The value of reduced disputes per asset is unknown.
